title: Programme 12 Precondition Capabilities
description: P12-005: Declared external capabilities consumed by Programme 12 (Platform Core) with diagnostic verification commands and graceful degradation strategies.

degradation.message: Node.js 18+ is required for executing platform scripts, compilers and gates.
Package resolution and workspace link verification cannot execute standalone without pnpm.
Commit scanning, authorship checks and diff validation are disabled outside a git working tree.
Live database connection is absent. Migrations, schema inspection and RLS verification fall back to static DDL validation and AST schema linting.
Design system package not installed in current scope. Documentation surfaces (Storybook, templates) use fallback CSS token definitions.
